review: Correctness and security, separate from product review
changes: Global settings validate metadata, transport, sources, startup preconditions and revision before a single profile save; failed startup changes do not commit the profile.
Settings writes preserve the latest signed directory; optimistic concurrency protects configuration and edited metadata.
SL6 invitations contain signed host/network/transport/expiry/entry information and a random application capability, with no member private keys or administrator key.
Capability-only rooms reject their six-digit legacy locator. A committed key exchange and owner SAS approval precede member credential issuance.
The guest pins room, host commitment and approved network identity; selected transport mismatch is rejected.

Restricted loopback, SID IPC authorization, one-use bootstrap, CSRF, operation replay protection and external-only CSP assets remain in force. Accepted mutations are observed rather than resent after a timeout.
